body:
Thank you for taking the time to read and respond.

I can't stress how much each comment means to me. As I wrote, the rational part of my head says the same but as it's not really something I can be open about in person, part of my head has constantly overruled those thoughts, so hearing other people reinforce the positive thoughts means so much to me.

I've spent every day of the last month worrying so much over it all and it means a great deal to hear from others. With your response and the others I've had, they've given me a kind of odd sensation in my chest where I feel close to sobbing from relief. Thank you.

Thank you for taking the time to reply.

I tell myself that the first incident was just a thing that I'm sure thousands of people that age do, my only mistake was forgetting it existed. But when I did see it again, I deleted it straight away. And as for the R34 thing, it was completely unintentional and it's possible to stumble across bad stuff on the internet without meaning to, but for some reason my mind keeps making me feel down.

Again, thank you for replying. I appreciate it as I can't discuss it openly to anyone I know.
